title: Flood Fill
statement: You are given an image as a grid of integers, where image[r][c] is the pixel's color, plus a starting pixel (sr, sc) and a new color. Repaint the starting pixel and every pixel connected to it 4-directionally (up/down/left/right) through pixels of the starting pixel's original color, using the new color. Return the resulting image as a list of lists. If the starting pixel already has the new color, return the image unchanged.
hints: Treat the grid as a graph: pixels are nodes, 4-directional neighbors of the same color are edges.
Record the starting pixel's original color first; only spread onto pixels that still have exactly that color, and guard the old == new case to avoid infinite spreading.
DFS or BFS from (sr, sc): pop a cell, if in bounds and still the old color, repaint it and push its four neighbors.
